text.tspan: SAFER — Security Deposit / FDR Technology Architecture
Modular monolith • authentic technology logos • actual prototype capture • synthetic demonstration
PRIVATE RUNTIME · LOGICAL APPLICATION AND SERVICE BOUNDARIES
Request IDs + timings · safe error categories
Local security-alert evidence and recovery drills
Source approvals · feature flags · spending limits
Secrets are private files, outside .env / repository
Messages stay in the local inbox
Bytes only / no database or key secrets
Committed outbox → relay → publish job IDs
Dependency + image / secret scans · SBOM artifacts
A1 budget: 2 OCPUs / 12 GB · operator deployment gates
Legend: solid arrows = implemented dependencies / configured checks · purple dashed = optional AI, disabled · grey dashed = pending integration / proposed deployment
*HTTPS front door is the local readiness profile; development uses a Vite proxy. Internal groups are logical boundaries, not independent microservices. No live bank or Oracle deployment is claimed.
